Access the online application form before the deadline of 22-10-2026.
Ensure you meet the essential qualification criteria and possess a provisional or final certificate.

important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and do not confer any right for regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI posts. Only candidates who have acquired essential qualifications and whose results have been declared (with at least a provisional certificate) are eligible to apply. Selected candidates must sign an undertaking to maintain the confidentiality of project findings and intellectual property.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces 1 confirmed post, with an anticipated total of up to 3 vacancies depending upon the availability of funds. Candidates will be selected from the waiting list.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following essential educational qualifications to be eligible for the Project Associate-I post: Essential Qualification: M.Sc. in Zoology / Freshwater Ecology / Aquatic Biology / Biodiversity / Aquatic Environment Management from a recognized University. Upper Age Limit: 35 years as reckoned on the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments depend on the candidate's qualification status: (a) Rs. 31,000/- + HRA: Applicable for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship or GATE, OR those who have qualified National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. (b) Rs. 25,000/- + HRA: Applicable for other candidates who do not fall under category (a) above. House Rent Allowance (HRA) shall be admissible as per applicable rules, and project staff must make their own arrangements for accommodation. The positions are purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, and tenure shall not exceed six or seven years as per CSIR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be required to perform the following duties: Field work Data collection Sample analysis Data compilation Assistance in report preparation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Visit the official CSIR-NEERI website at https://www.neeri.res.in . Access the online application form before the deadline of 22-10-2026. Ensure you meet the essential qualification criteria and possess a provisional or final certificate. Submit the online application form as per the portal instructions. No application fee is required.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be done on the basis of an Online Interview conducted through MS Team, Skype, or similar platforms. The specific date of the interview will be notified separately on the official website. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for the online interview based on criteria adopted by the Screening Committee.
